needs.thing: a barge moored in the river pool by the camp, with a furnished hold a person can stand in and a door that locks (Black Marsh & Valenwood's Imperial ship and its hold cell `01dock3to4`)

signs.detail: Black Marsh & Valenwood's Imperial ship moored against the camp's bank, its hold door on the deck

needs.why: Not met yet. The ship lies moored in the pool by the camp with its furnished hold behind a ship's door, and the cook Okeeh works at the hold's spit pot. But the ship's deck round the hold door is not joined to the bank: two dock pieces run from the ship's lower deck to the bank, and the deck the door opens on has no walked way down to them, so a player who comes out of the hold cannot walk ashore.
needs.fit: The barge is the right thing in the right place; only the way ashore is missing.
needs.narrow: Yes: a gangway from the deck at the hold door to the bank (the join), or the door moved to the lower deck the gangway already reaches.
